name: kabuto/framework
description: A zero-dependency, NestJS-style micro framework for PHP.

suggest.revolt/event-loop: Enables the high-performance fiber-based Revolt event-loop runtime on Windows and Linux.
suggest.ext-openswoole: Enables the ultra-high-performance C++ coroutine HTTP runtime on Linux/Docker (pecl install openswoole).
suggest.spiral/roadrunner-http: Enables official RoadRunner worker integration (or use Kabuto built-in zero-dependency RoadRunner driver).
